test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
‘P # Q’ means ‘P is the wife of Q’.

‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’.

‘P & Q’ means ‘P is the son of Q’.

‘P @ Q’ means ‘P is the mother of Q’.

If A % B # C % D & B @ E, then how is A related to E?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 #
 @
 &
 %
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Mother
 Son
 Father
 
 

 

Given: A % B # C % D & B @ E

It means A is father of B, B is wife of C, C is father of D, D is son of B, B is mother of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4da6053fce56067bcb01404d07a80bedd2795ee2affb317b31b81a23b1421a7.png] 

Thus, A is the '**Mother’s father' **of E.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
